questions.question: What is the name of the force you feel pushing against your hand when you hold it out of a moving car window?
questions.explanation: You nailed it! That push you feel is drag, which is the air working against the object moving through it.

questions.question: Which shape helps a vehicle slip through the air the fastest?
questions.explanation: Exactly right! A smooth, teardrop shape helps the air slide right over, making it perfect for speed.

questions.question: What do we call the special force that pushes an airplane up into the sky?
questions.explanation: You got it! Lift is the invisible boost that helps airplanes fly high above the clouds.

questions.question: Why do engineers design airplane wings with a curve on the top and a flatter bottom?
options: To create a difference in air pressure that helps the plane fly
questions.explanation: Amazing! That clever wing shape creates the pressure difference needed to lift that giant plane right off the ground.
